goal_ru: Сказать, кто ты и какой ты: I am, he is, they are.
notes: am/is/are with all pronouns and nouns; contractions I'm, he's, they're; it vs he/she; no verb after be ('I am play' trap)

goal_ru: Спросить «Ты готов?» и ответить коротко: Yes, I am.
notes: isn't/aren't/I'm not; Are you...? Is he...?; short answers Yes, I am / No, he isn't; word order in questions; Where is...?

goal_ru: Не путать I/me/my, he/him/his, they/them/their.
notes: subject vs object vs possessive adjective; mine/yours briefly; its vs it's

goal_ru: Сказать «два мяча», «три коробки», «пять детей».
notes: -s, -es (box, bus, match), -ies (city), -ves (knife), irregular: men, women, children, feet, teeth, mice, people; uncountables have no plural (information, advice) briefly

title_ru: Артикли a / an / the и this, that, these, those
goal_ru: Поставить a, an или the и показать «этот / тот».
notes: a/an by sound (an hour, a uniform); the = known/unique; no article with plural general and names; play hockey (no article with sports); this/that/these/those

goal_ru: Сказать, что где есть: There is a rink near my house.
notes: there is + singular/uncountable, there are + plural; negative and questions; some/any basics; Is there...? Yes, there is

goal_ru: Рассказать, что у тебя есть: I have got a new stick.
notes: have got/has got; haven't/hasn't got; Have you got...?; American English prefers have / do you have — teach both, mark have got as British

goal_ru: Сказать, что умеешь и чего не умеешь.
notes: can + base verb (no to, no -s); can't/cannot; Can you skate? Yes, I can; requests Can I...?

goal_ru: Рассказать о привычках: He plays hockey every day.
notes: he/she/it + -s; spelling -es (watches, goes, does), -ies (studies, but plays); has; everyday time words every day, on Mondays

goal_ru: Сказать, чего не делаешь: She doesn't like phonk.
notes: don't/doesn't + base verb; trap: doesn't plays; he don't; I not play

title_ru: Present Simple: вопросы с do / does
goal_ru: Спросить: Does he play Brawl Stars? — Yes, he does.
notes: Do/Does + subject + base verb; short answers; wh-questions: Where do you live? What does he like?; trap: Does he plays; You like hockey? without do

goal_ru: Сказать, как часто: I usually train after school.
notes: always/usually/often/sometimes/never; position before main verb but after be; How often...? once/twice a week

goal_ru: Задать вопрос со словами what, where, who, why, how.
notes: what, where, when, who, why, how, how many/how much, how old, how often, which, whose; who as subject (Who plays?) vs object

goal_ru: Сказать «клюшка Тома», «раздевалка игроков».
notes: 's singular, s' plural, children's; of for things (the end of the game); it's vs its

goal_ru: Сказать, когда: at 7 o'clock, on Monday, in May.
notes: at + time/night/the weekend(BrE), on + days/dates, in + months/years/seasons/parts of day; no preposition with next/last/every

goal_ru: Сказать, где что лежит: The puck is under the bench.
notes: in, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between, opposite, near; at home/at school/in the city

goal_ru: Дать команду и предложить: Pass the puck! Let's go!
notes: imperative base verb; Don't...; Let's + base verb; Let's not; polite please

goal_ru: Сказать, что любишь делать: I love playing Roblox.
notes: like/love/hate/enjoy + -ing; want/would like + to; spelling of -ing (running, making); trap: I like play

goal_ru: Сказать, что происходит прямо сейчас: Rex is blocking the puck.
notes: am/is/are + -ing; spelling (swimming, writing, lying); now, at the moment, Look!; trap: He playing (no is)

goal_ru: Спросить: What are you doing? — I'm not watching, I'm playing.
notes: isn't/aren't + -ing; Are you...ing?; What is he doing?; short answers

goal_ru: Различать «обычно» и «сейчас».
notes: habits vs now; signal words; temporary situations this week; Russian has one present — main trap

goal_ru: Понять, почему нельзя сказать I am knowing.
notes: know, like, love, want, need, understand, believe, belong, have (possession), see/hear; think (opinion vs process)

title_ru: Some / any, much / many, a lot of
goal_ru: Сказать «немного», «много», «нет ни одного».
notes: countable vs uncountable; some/any; much/many/a lot of; a few/a little; How much/how many; no + noun

goal_ru: Сказать, где ты был и каким было: The game was amazing.
notes: was/were; wasn't/weren't; Were you...?; there was/were; yesterday, last week, ago

goal_ru: Рассказать, что было вчера: We played and won.
notes: -ed; spelling: stopped, studied, played, liked; pronunciation /t/ /d/ /ɪd/ (recognition); time words

goal_ru: Использовать went, saw, got, took в рассказе.
notes: most common irregular past forms in sentences: go-went, see-saw, get-got, take-took, have-had, make-made, come-came, do-did, buy-bought, win-won, lose-lost, score? (regular); link to the irregular verbs block

goal_ru: Спросить: Did you win? — No, we didn't.
notes: didn't + base verb; Did + subject + base; wh-questions What did you do?; trap: didn't went, Did you saw

goal_ru: Рассказать историю: I was skating when Rex fell.
notes: was/were + -ing; when + past simple, while + past continuous; background vs event

goal_ru: Рассказать о планах: I'm going to watch the game.
notes: plans/intentions; prediction from evidence (Look at the clouds, it's going to snow); negative and questions

title_ru: Will и will или going to
goal_ru: Пообещать, решить сейчас, предсказать: I'll help you!
notes: will for instant decisions, promises, offers, predictions (I think...); won't; will vs going to

goal_ru: Сравнить игроков, команды и вещи.
notes: -er/-est, double consonant (bigger), -ier (easier), more/most, good-better-best, bad-worse-worst, far; than; as ... as / not as ... as

goal_ru: Сказать «надо», «нельзя», «стоит».
notes: must/mustn't (rules, strong), have to/don't have to (necessity / no need), should/shouldn't (advice); mustn't vs don't have to trap

title_ru: Наречия: quickly, well; too и enough
goal_ru: Сказать, как что-то делают, и «слишком / достаточно».
notes: -ly adverbs, irregular well/fast/hard; adverbs of degree very/really/quite/so; too + adj, adj + enough, enough + noun

goal_ru: Сказать «я когда-нибудь…» и «я уже…»: Have you ever been to Canada?
notes: have/has + past participle; ever/never; been vs gone basics; past participles of common irregular verbs

title_ru: Present Perfect: just, already, yet, for, since
goal_ru: Сказать «только что», «уже», «ещё не» и «с тех пор как».
notes: just/already/yet positions; for vs since; Present Perfect vs Past Simple (finished time words)

goal_ru: Решать, где нужен the, а где артикля нет.
notes: the with unique things, instruments (play the guitar), the + superlative; zero article: sports, meals, languages, at school/at home, by bus; American usage notes (go to the hospital)

title_ru: Present Perfect Continuous; been или gone
goal_ru: Сказать «я тренируюсь уже два часа».
notes: have/has been + -ing, duration with for/since, How long...?; has gone to vs has been to/in

goal_ru: Сказать, что случилось раньше другого прошлого.
notes: had + V3; when/after/before/by the time; sequence of past events; Past Perfect Continuous for recognition

goal_ru: Сказать, что раньше было иначе: I used to hate skating.
notes: used to + base; didn't use to; Did you use to...?; be/get used to + -ing (recognition and simple use)

goal_ru: Сказать, что что-то делают или сделали: The game was won.
notes: is/are + V3, was/were + V3, by; when to use; causative have something done (recognition)

goal_ru: Выбрать: decide to go или enjoy going.
notes: verbs + to (decide, want, hope, plan, learn) vs + -ing (enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, practise); after prepositions -ing; stop/remember/try with both (simple level)

goal_ru: Сказать: If we win, we will go to the final.
notes: zero conditional (facts), first conditional (if + present, will); unless = if not; when vs if; trap: If it will rain

title_ru: Если бы: If I had…, I would…
goal_ru: Помечтать: If I had a million, I would…
notes: second conditional: if + past, would + base; If I were; unreal now vs real future

goal_ru: Пересказать, что сказал тренер.
notes: say/tell; tense backshift (is→was, will→would, can→could); pronoun and time changes; reported questions (asked if/where) basics; reported commands told me to

goal_ru: Сказать «он, должно быть, устал» и «не может быть».
notes: must be (sure yes), might/may/could be (maybe), can't be (sure no); deductions about present
